function.name: falkordb_query
function.description: Query the company graph (people, teams, projects, tickets, documents, decisions, chat messages and how they connect). Accepts a natural-language request or a read-only Cypher query; every result row is a citable source.

query.description: What to search for, or read-only Cypher. Examples: 'Who owns <project name>', 'List all decisions', 'budget cut', 'MATCH (d:Decision) WHERE d.status = "Active" RETURN d.key, d.title'
